title: Attempting to make transparent wood
summary: NileRed attempts to make transparent wood, inspired by an AvE video, by removing lignin and infiltrating the wood with resin. It is a long, detailed walkthrough of the chemistry and the practical difficulties.
why: Linked as the go-to hands-on demonstration of how transparent wood is made and why scaling it to large pieces is hard.

quote.text: NileRed on youtube has a cool video detailing the steps to create transparent wood.
